description: Task 19: Add merchant operations, telemetry, and recovery evidence. Build merchant-scoped operator APIs in the Operations Console, dashboards/alerts/replay commands, support grants, runbooks. Exercise rotation, backup/restore, outage, queue backlog, crash, and offboarding scenarios. Scan storage/telemetry for credentials.
steps: Create apps/operations-console/src/lib/operator-api.ts with merchant-scoped operator API types and client: (a) listMerchantTransactions(merchantId, filters), (b) getTransactionDetail(txId), (c) retryTransaction(txId), (d) voidTransaction(txId), (e) issueRefund(txId, amount), (f) suspendMerchant(merchantId, reason), (g) grantSupportAccess(merchantId, grantConfig), (h) exportAuditLog(merchantId, dateRange)

Create apps/operations-console/src/lib/projections.ts with operations console data projections: TransactionProjection (flattened view for operator dashboards), MerchantHealthProjection (aggregated health metrics), AlertProjection (threshold-based alerts), QueueProjection (job queue status)

Create apps/operations-console/src/lib/telemetry-dashboard.ts with dashboard metric definitions: (a) transaction success/failure rates, (b) reconciliation latency, (c) provider response times, (d) queue depth and processing rate, (e) error rates by category, (f) kill switch activation history

Create apps/operations-console/src/lib/recovery-commands.ts with recovery/replay commands: (a) ReplayCommand for re-processing failed/stuck transactions, (b) RotateCredentialsCommand for key rotation flow, (c) BackupRestoreCommand for merchant data backup/restore, (d) DrainQueueCommand for graceful queue drain, (e) ForceReconcileCommand for manual reconciliation trigger

Create apps/operations-console/src/lib/runbooks.ts with structured runbook definitions: (a) OutageRunbook (detection, isolation, recovery steps), (b) QueueBacklogRunbook (monitoring, drain, replay), (c) CrashRecoveryRunbook (state assessment, replay, verification), (d) OffboardingRunbook (suspension, data export, cleanup, verification), (e) RotationRunbook (credential rotation without downtime)

Create apps/operations-console/src/lib/credential-scanner.ts with secret scanning: (a) scanStorageForCredentials() checks stored data for patterns matching FORBIDDEN_CREDENTIAL_FIELDS from payment-sdk, (b) scanTelemetryForCredentials() checks log/metric payloads, (c) ScanResult with severity and remediation guidance

Create apps/operations-console/src/lib/support-grants.ts with support grant management: (a) SupportGrant type (scoped, time-limited, audited), (b) createSupportGrant() with mandatory reason and expiry, (c) revokeSupportGrant(), (d) listActiveGrants(merchantId)

Create apps/operations-console/src/lib/operator-api.test.ts testing: operator API type safety, projection correctness, recovery command validation, credential scanner detection patterns, support grant lifecycle
Update apps/operations-console/src/app/page.tsx with operations dashboard layout. Create apps/operations-console/src/app/layout.tsx with navigation. Update package.json if needed.
Create apps/operations-console/src/lib/types.ts with all operations console types.
acceptance_criteria: Merchant-scoped operator APIs exist with proper type definitions
Operations console projections flatten complex domain data for operator views
Telemetry dashboard defines metrics for transaction health, provider performance, and queue status
Recovery commands cover replay, rotation, backup/restore, drain, and force-reconcile
Runbooks exist for outage, queue backlog, crash recovery, offboarding, and rotation
Credential scanner detects forbidden patterns from payment-sdk FORBIDDEN_CREDENTIAL_FIELDS
Support grants are scoped, time-limited, and audited
verification: export NVM_DIR=/opt/toolchains/.nvm && source $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/counterX && pnpm --filter @counter/operations-console build && pnpm --filter @counter/operations-console test
findings: All 110 tests pass (89 new tests across operator-api, projections, telemetry-dashboard, recovery-commands, runbooks, credential-scanner, support-grants + 21 existing). Build succeeds cleanly. ESLint required using typeof checks instead of direct method references to avoid unbound-method warnings. RECONCILIATION_LATENCY and PROVIDER_RESPONSE_TIME imports needed to remain for the toContain assertions.
